name: cardforge-owner
description: Inspect and operate CardForge's Owner-controlled public property and operational state.

interface.longDescription: Inspect CardForge's public presentation, workspace health, analytics, MCP usage, provider readiness, and accountable Owner activity, and publish revision-safe site copy, public settings, identity, Founder, Experience, legal, roadmap and media changes through the same revision-safe Owner authority used by the browser. Review exact Pipeline source evidence, editorial decisions and publication overrides through canonical Owner commands. CardForge Studio remains a separate creator plugin.
defaultPrompt: Check the current CardForge site and tell me what needs attention.
Show me CardForge provider readiness and explain any gaps.
What Owner changes have happened recently?
